data.name: Frontline: Operation Kosmonaut
data.detailed_description:
The Cold War was not fought in public.

  • Northern Soviet territory.

A classified orbital facility has fallen into the hands of rogue officers.

The operation is internal.
The mission is unofficial.
Failure is not an option.

You are part of a Spetsnaz unit tasked with reclaiming the facility, eliminating the traitors, and securing the Kosmonaut satellite program before it threatens military stability.

There will be no recognition.
No reports.
Only orders.

A Grounded Cold War FPS

FRONTLINE: OPERATION KOSMONAUT is a focused, story-driven first-person shooter inspired by classic military titles from the late 1990s and early 2000s.

No modern gimmicks.
No open-world distractions.
No regenerating health.

Only tactical combat under extreme conditions.

Features

• Authentic 1987 Cold War setting
• Play as a Soviet Spetsnaz soldier
• Linear, tightly designed campaign
• No regenerating health — medkits are essential
• Tactical enemy AI
• Snowstorms, radar installations, concrete bunkers, and missile hangars
• Minimal HUD for maximum immersion
• Retro-inspired design with modern technical stability

Brutal Conditions. Limited Intelligence.

Fight your way through:

Frozen outposts

Cramped Soviet bunker complexes

Underground tunnels

An active missile assembly hall

A control center under red alert

Every decision matters.
Every mistake has consequences.

In the Spirit of Classic Military Shooters

FRONTLINE focuses on atmosphere, tension, and disciplined combat.

If you miss the days when shooters were direct, cold, and uncompromisingly linear — this is your mission.

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains depictions of violence, including the use of firearms in a military combat setting. Players engage in combat against human enemies, which may involve shooting, explosions, and environmental destruction.

The game includes visual effects such as blood impacts and combat-related audio. The overall tone is serious and grounded in a Cold War-era military scenario.

There are no depictions of sexual content, sexual violence, or self-harm. The game may include references to military conflict and hostile environments.
